turns.q: Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
turns.replyTail:
if you’re brand new, our Kit Builder is the best place to start. It lets you pick a warmer and a few best-selling scents so you can find what you like.
Here are a few beginner tips:



Read your warmer’s instructions first.


Start with 2–3 bears in a small warmer.


Use 3–7 bears in a larger warmer.


Swap the wax once the scent fades.



If you’d like, I can also help you choose scents by vibe, like fresh, fruity, floral, or cozy.
Let me know if you have any other questions or want more tips!

How do I use it properly the very first time?
For your first use:



Read the warmer instructions first.


If it uses a light bulb, make sure to remove any plastic around the bulb.


Set it on a safe surface and plug it in.


Add 2–3 Happy Wax bears or 1 wax cube.


Don’t add water or oil.


Turn it on, or set the timer if your warmer has one.



If your warmer has a silicone dish, you won’t need an extra liner.
If you have any other questions or need more tips, feel free to ask!
